items.title: Genie 4 is now available
items.excerpt: Google DeepMind rolls out a new Project Genie experience with its Genie 4 world model to eligible Google AI Ultra subscribers, adding real-time prompt edits inside a generated world, chainable worlds and a community gallery for remixing; a day later Genie 4 also opened on the Gemini API for 720p interactive worlds with native audio. Follow-up to the 10-28 Genie 4 model debut (games).

items.title: Canva adds an AI 'off' button
items.excerpt: Canva is rolling out settings that let users and teams switch off most of its generative AI features and filter AI-made images, saying AI does not suit every task; some AI tools stay on.
